0022600123.text: The Bucks, 0-3 and on a three-game losing streak, host the Indiana Pacers (2-1, winners of their last game), who are 5th in the East and 2nd in the Central. Milwaukee won the last four meetings in the 2025-26 season, including a 134-123 home win on March 15, 2026, and this season's series has no games yet. Indiana will be without Ben Sheppard (knee) and Johnny Furphy (knee, surgery), both out, and T.J. McConnell (hamstring), also out, while Ivica Zubac is day-to-day with an ankle sprain and is a game-time decision.
